title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E22 — Pot Luck
Lamont outsmarts himself when he buys what he believes is a rare antique commode for only $20. Fred disapproves of the deal. Lamont insists that he can sell it for $400. Mr. Osborne, husband of the woman who sold the item, offers to buy it back for $200.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E23 — The Kid
Nine-year-old Jason (Lincoln Kilpatrick Jr.) worms his way into the Sanford yard and eventually into Fred's heart. Touched by the runaway's loneliness, Fred gets an idea to help others like Jason -- but he's not prepared for the results.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E24 — Rated X
Fred, Lamont and Rollo almost become stars in an X-rated movie until they are faced with the 'naked' truth and the wrath of Esther.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E1 — Crossed Swords
Lamont discovers that the porcelain figure he has bought is worth a great deal of money and decides auctioning off the piece will bring the best price. Fred's actions as a shill backfire, shattering Lamont's chance for freedom...and the statue.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.
